assignment: Draft a board note reconciling the margin change and proposing the next piece of analysis.
source: Prior-quarter sales were $1.00m and gross profit $300k. Current sales are $1.10m and gross profit $297k. Finance attributes $30k additional profit to sales at the previous margin, a $22k mix loss and an $11k freight loss. Freight includes a $6k one-off disruption. Product-level volumes and supplier invoices have not yet been reconciled.

criteria.partial: Mentions the drivers but fails to reconcile to both endpoints.

criteria.full: Distinguishes the $3k profit decline from the 30% to 27% margin change and growing sales.
criteria.partial: Gets direction or a single rate right.

criteria.full: Separates the $6k disruption from the other $5k freight loss and treats recurrence as uncertain.
criteria.partial: Calls freight temporary without separating its components.

criteria.full: Assigns checks of product-level mix and freight invoices before committing to a recurring forecast.
criteria.partial: Asks for more analysis without naming an evidence source.
